video_title: Dylan Harper on his preparation and calmness in the NBA Finals 🙌  | SC with SVP

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on his focus on rebounding and defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing for me besides the plus minus is the opportunity battle
quotes.quote: The biggest thing for me besides the plus minus is the opportunity battle. I feel like the rebounds, the offensive rebounds, defensive rebounds, and just seeing places where we can improve at. I feel like the biggest thing is getting on the boards. They got a few offensive rebounds and that is the biggest thing we got to clean up.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on maintaining composure during his first NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: if I come out here and I'm nervous and I'm being antsy and I'm second guessing myself
quotes.quote: This is every kid's dream. If I come out here and I'm nervous and I'm being antsy and I'm second guessing myself, I feel like I'm doing a disservice to everyone. So when I get on the floor, I feel like I'm prepared and I'm ready to go in any situation I'm in.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on his shooting confidence despite missing shots
quotes.excerpt: they all feel good coming out my hands. They just didn't go in today.
quotes.quote: They all feel good coming out my hands. They just didn't go in today.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the intensity of playing in Madison Square Garden
quotes.excerpt: we came out and Jay-Z just walked by me. Little things like that
quotes.quote: I think before the game, we came out and Jay-Z just walked by me. Little things like that. I used to do my pregame prayer during it and I couldn't focus. It was so loud in here. So I feel like the environment we're in, it's the best.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on maintaining momentum after a strong first quarter
quotes.excerpt: when we get off to a good start, we just got to keep the momentum.
quotes.quote: When we get off to a good start, we just got to keep the momentum. I feel like there's a couple plays in the second half where we allowed them to stay in the game and allowed them to come back. If we clean those up, I feel like the sky's the limit for us.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on Victor Wembanyama's dominance in the paint
quotes.excerpt: he's at his best when he's in the paint and I think we all know that.
quotes.quote: That was a big thing, just staying in attack mode. I feel like for him, he's at his best when he's in the paint and I think we all know that. You see it from game to game and I feel like his ability to get in the paint and our ability as guards just to throw it up there and trust him.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on Stefan Castle's impact on both ends
quotes.excerpt: he guards the best player, he makes big time plays for us
quotes.quote: That's just the type of guy he is. He's a winner. I feel like the impact he has on the game is second to none. He guards the best player, he makes big time plays for us. So his impact every game, but especially this game, just kind of uplifted us.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on Victor Wembanyama's stoic demeanor
quotes.excerpt: I try to get him to smile a little bit. He won't smile for nothing.
quotes.quote: I try to get him to smile a little bit. He won't smile for nothing.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on staying focused during the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: we came here to get the job done and the biggest thing for us is staying locked in
quotes.quote: We came here to get the job done and the biggest thing for us is staying locked in and staying focused.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on his sister's motivation for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: if you lose this game, I'm going to go to San Antonio and take your dogs.
quotes.quote: If you lose this game, I'm going to go to San Antonio and take your dogs. She loves dogs and I love my dogs. I'm playing as hard as I can.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on the support of family and friends
quotes.excerpt: being close to home is second to none. You got all your family, friends, old coaches
quotes.quote: Being close to home is second to none. You got all your family, friends, old coaches, just right across the bridge from you.
